parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Use chain rule at least once. [M1] Guidance: need $dy/dt=(1/\tan t)d(\tan t)/dt$, or $dx/dt=(-1)(\cos t)^{-2}d(\cos t)/dt$. BOD if the plus and the $(-1)(-1)$ are not seen.
Obtain $dx/dt=\sec t\tan t$. [A1] Guidance: from MF19; if $dx/dt=-\sec t\tan t$, M1 A0. Exact equivalent such as $\sin t(\cos t)^{-2}$ allowed. If written with variable $x$ or $\theta$, condone recovery on the next line.
Obtain $dy/dt=\sec^2t/\tan t$. [A1] Guidance: equivalent $1/(\sin t\cos t)$; if written with variable $x$ or $\theta$, condone recovery on the next line. Only penalise notation errors once in $dx/dt$ and $dy/dt$ if no recovery.
Use $dy/dx=(dy/dt)\div(dx/dt)$. [M1] Guidance: allow even if previous M0, but must be using derivatives.
Obtain $dy/dx=\cos t/\sin^2t$. [A1 AG] Guidance: after the quotient is used, any notation error A0; must cancel $\cos t$ correctly. Total: 5.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
State or imply $t=\pi/4$ when $y=0$. [B1]
Form the tangent equation at $y=0$ or find $c$. [M1] Guidance: $x=\sqrt2$, $dy/dx=\sqrt2$, $y=0$; use their coordinates and gradient in $y=mx+c$.
Obtain $y=\sqrt2x-2$. [A1 OE] Guidance: e.g. $y=\sqrt2(x-\sqrt2)$; ISW. Allow $y=1.41x-2.00$ or $1.41(x-1.41)$. Total: 3.
